outcome_summary: All five acceptance-criteria misfiling issues (I1–I5) were resolved through persona-source-only changes across six Markdown/YAML files — no MCP server code modifications. The fixes span three layers: the Bootstrapper now registers WPs before creating spec files (eliminating rename-induced ID mismatches) and enforces a single-source AC transcription rule; a content-level verification gate was added at both Bootstrapper (warn) and PM (self-heal) checkpoints; and the Planner/WP Decomposer now emit numbered AC identifiers with a coverage table, while Developer and QA personas received explicit verbatim-copy guidance. All 5 WPs and 20 pipeline stages passed cleanly with 4 insights committed to the knowledge base.
